head: 89a339d3111e52919bf2efef016936fb047e145c
claim: An app on Node reaches its host on a cloud computer over plain SSH to the machine's loopback (ssh -N -L through sshResolve and sshTransport), with no Tailscale and the app port listening on 127.0.0.1 only; a changed host key is refused with host-key

steps.start: Built workspace SDK (npm run build exit 0; @byokit/cloud 0.4.0 resolves to packages/cloud/dist). A fresh Ubuntu 24.04 KVM VM booted from the Ubuntu cloud image (SHA256 checked against Ubuntu SHA256SUMS) with an ada user, no Tailscale, sshd on a loopback-only port. Nothing pre-configured on the box.
steps: Ran the forward drive capture/cloud-ssh-forward.mjs with the Ubuntu image, the pinned Node 24.15.0 x64 sha256 and the KVM image in docker.
Waited for cloud-init to finish on the VM and read the ED25519 host key printed on its console.
Read the server's host key over the system ssh binary through sshHostKey and compared it with the console fingerprint; confirmed it.
Ran setup with no address: checking access, listing, inspecting, installing Node and the host app, ready.
Opened an ssh -N -L forward with sshResolve over sshTransport and requested the host through the rewritten loopback address; got 'runner up for Ada'.
Checked the listeners on the box: only 127.0.0.1:7300; checked tailscale on the box: none, inactive.
Closed the forward and requested again so it was reopened on a new local port.
Pinned a wrong host key and tried to connect; the connection was refused with host-key: the pinned host key no longer matches.
Let the driver remove the VM and its container.
steps.result: The app on Node reached its host through a plain SSH local forward to the box's loopback: 'runner up for Ada' came back. The app port 7300 listens on 127.0.0.1 only, tailscale is none and inactive, the forward reopened after close, and a changed host key was refused with host-key. Log: cloud-ssh-forward-drive.txt ends with result: PASS.
